subsystems.name: Graphene oxide sheets
subsystems.role: 2D carbon sheets that assemble into the aerogel's walls.

subsystems.name: Porous network
subsystems.role: interconnected 3D pore structure giving ultra-low density.

subsystems.name: Crosslinkers
subsystems.role: bind sheets together to strengthen the network.

subsystems.name: Composite matrix (optional)
subsystems.role: second phase to add mechanical strength or specific function.

subsystems.name: Functional additives
subsystems.role: tune properties like hydrophobicity, conductivity or catalytic activity.

buildSteps.title: Oxidize graphite to graphene oxide
buildSteps.detail: graphite is treated with strong acids and oxidants to attach oxygen groups, making it dispersible in water.

buildSteps.title: Disperse and exfoliate
buildSteps.detail: sonication or stirring separates stacked sheets into a stable aqueous suspension.

buildSteps.title: Gelation
buildSteps.detail: the suspension is heated or chemically treated so sheets self-assemble into a 3D hydrogel network; crosslinkers may be added.

buildSteps.title: Freeze-drying
buildSteps.detail: the hydrogel is frozen and the ice is sublimated under vacuum, leaving a porous aerogel without collapsing the structure.

buildSteps.title: Thermal reduction
buildSteps.detail: heating in inert gas removes oxygen groups, converting graphene oxide to reduced graphene oxide and increasing electrical conductivity.

buildSteps.title: Composite infiltration
buildSteps.detail: if making a composite, a polymer or ceramic precursor is drawn into the pores and cured, forming an interpenetrating network.

buildSteps.title: Shaping and finishing
buildSteps.detail: the monolith is cut, coated or densified to meet the target application, such as thermal shielding or filtration.
